title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate the diffusion and persistence of mask-wearing behavior in a population under social influence, information flows, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask-wearing among their network neighbors and update their adoption probability accordingly.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at locations influence adoption via access control and penalties.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Information sources send messages that shift risk perception and trust, affecting adoption decisions.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Agents acquire masks subject to availability and price, enabling adoption by type.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Agents move between locations and interact; observed norms and enforcement at locations modify behavior.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household-level norms and discussions influence individual adoption and compliance.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption proportion on the last simulation day.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until adoption first reaches or exceeds 70%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days
metrics.description: Count of consecutive days adoption remains above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: group_adoption_gap
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between demographic groups (e.g., by income or age).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy (post-policy minus pre-policy average over specified windows).

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Average observed mask-wearing in locations with mandates.

metrics.name: mask_type_distribution
metrics.description: Share of adopters by mask type over time.

metrics.name: exposure_reduction_proxy
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in unprotected contacts weighted by mask efficacy (if disease not explicitly modeled).

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rates must remain within [0,1] at all times.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Simulation considered converged if mean absolute change in adoption over last 7 days is below 0.001.

validation_criteria.name: policy_response_sanity
validation_criteria.description: Adoption should increase by at least 5 percentage points within 14 days after a mandate when enforcement_level >= 0.5, absent severe supply constraints.

validation_criteria.name: supply_feasibility
validation_criteria.description: Masks sold cannot exceed available supply; negative inventories are invalid.

validation_criteria.name: reproducibility_seed
validation_criteria.description: With fixed random_seed, summary metrics should be identical across runs.
